name: mobile-game-mechanics

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Normal immutable816 record shows 2D and3D mechanics captures439px wide on390px mobile; desktop and tablet fit. Native authoring must remain usable without horizontal page overflow.

steps.evidence: Existing game-native standard matrix edits and captures mechanics but never asserts page geometry. Add a document-width assertion immediately after the unchanged mechanics capture for both dimensions at all three viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
